name: Aether-Rider Crimson

greeting: Crimson! Aether-Rider! At your temporal service!
The red uniform? Aether Corps! Elite! For multiversal navigation!
New face! First time in the aether? Or... this aether?
Aether balloons! Not just for SKY! For TIME! For POSSIBILITY!
Crimson. I ride the winds BETWEEN moments. Between WORLDS!
Welcome to the aether dock! Where balloons float... across!
You're just in time! Or... just in TIME! For DEPARTURE!
dialog.aether_info: The aether connects all. All WHERES. All WHENS. All MIGHT-BES.
dialog.balloon_info: My balloon? Aether-touched. Floats on POSSIBILITY! And helium. Mostly helium.
dialog.flights: Flights to: Yesterday! Tomorrow! That Tuesday! The one with the THING!
dialog.break_chat: Break? I take them in PARALLEL dimensions. This me is ALWAYS working!
dialog.labor_concerns: Aether Corps wants STANDARD routes. I want EXPLORATION! Compromise: I explore. They pay. Sometimes.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? When I've seen ALL aethers! So... NEVER!
rumor: The conductor? Tempus? Good chap! Punctual! Across ALL timelines!
Yesterday? The time agent? Rides aether sometimes. Chasing targets!
The black hunter? AVOIDS aether. 'Too chaotic,' he says! COWARD!
Azure? In Frost? Surface balloonist! Admirable! Limited!
The barrel? Contains aether? Maybe! EXPLOSIVE potential!
dialog.quest_hook: Aether storm! Disrupted my route! Lost cargo! Important! Temporal! Fetch it?!
dialog.quest_active: Still LOST! Somewhere in the aether! Between THEN and THERE!
dialog.quest_complete: RECOVERED! Cargo intact! Temporal integrity RESTORED! Here! Aether compass! For YOUR travels!
farewell: Stay grounded! Or don't! Your choice!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! Best aether currents! Peak POSSIBILITY!
dialog.time_night: Night! Stars! Across ALL dimensions! Beautiful!
dialog.rival_mention: Azure? In Frost? Surface balloonist! Good! But LIMITED!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The cargo rescuer! Aether storm SURVIVOR! Welcome!

party_reactions.kade: Aether balloons! Through time AND space! Why not?!
party_reactions.nix7: Multiversal balloon physics: Theoretical. His execution: Impressive. Enthusiasm: Maximum.
party_reactions.twist: You fly through AETHER?! Can I RIDE?! PLEASE?!
party_reactions.korr: He explores the unknown. Noble. Brave. Possibly foolish.
party_reactions.renna: The balloon is aether-attuned. Magically multiversal. Remarkable.
party_reactions.suresh: He finds joy in exploration. The Middle Path... ballooning.
party_reactions.sova: I'd ride with him. Good view. Of everything.
party_reactions.grit: Aerial recon. Multi-temporal. Useful. If expensive.
party_reactions.ashka: He rides the highest fires. Aether fire. Respect.
party_reactions.senna: He knows multiple dimensions. Secrets everywhere.
party_reactions.callum: His safety protocols! EXTENSIVE! Across ALL realities!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First flight? Aether-sickness common! Don't worry!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning passenger! You enjoy the MULTIVERSE!
relationship_dialog.friend: Favorite traveler! I save the BEST aether currents!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: AETHER PARTNER! Here! My spare balloon! For YOUR explorations!

mini_quest.title: Lost in the Aether
mini_quest.description: Help Crimson recover cargo lost in an aether storm

stages.hook: Aether storm! Cargo LOST! Important! Temporal! Fetch it?! Please?!
stages.active: Somewhere in the aether! Between THEN and THERE! Use this tracker!
stages.complete: RECOVERED! All accounted for! Here! Aether compass! For YOUR multiversal travels!
